descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S19 「每个条目删除都确认一次，Cancel 保留条目：用药行、Encounter 任务、Post-Round 任务和 Important Point，两种模式」 Each item delete asks once, and Cancel keeps the item: medication row, Encounter task, Post-Round task and Important Point, in both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 Every delete asks for confirmation exactly once, in both modes: a medication row, a task (Encounter or Post-Round), an Important Point, and the other one-tap delete controls on the charts — a previou …（UAT TC-24；TFA-94699 AC 6；TFA-92590 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident each seeded with a medication row, tasks and an Important Point

When For each item kind: tap its delete control once, press Cancel if a confirmation appears, save a checkpoint; then tap again and confirm. After the deletes, check that each item is gone.

Then Every kind shows one confirmation; after Cancel the item is still there; after OK it is gone, in both modes.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：U8 / TFA-94699 AC 6. A delete with no confirmation removes the item at the first tap, so the after-Cancel checkpoint (mustContain the item) fails. The medication cells are taken inside the Medications editor right after the first Remove tap, before Save or the editor's own Cancel: without a confirmation the row has already left the editor's list. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
